home the man who made them a family. This movie could easily have been a five out of five stars movie. The story is not that bad but the script and the special effects are absolutely ludicrous. Do not get me wrong, the special effects are, in terms of visual effects quality, really good but they are also utterly unbelievable.

Might be the dumbest of the franchise to date, and if nothing else, that's an achievement. More importantly, Fate of the Furious continues the tradition that the series has upheld since all the way back in the... half-way point: Fast 5. That was when these movies actually got bearable, and Fate of the Furious delivers on the promise of that fun.
